_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround kwenye {width}x{height} grid.
Wewe ni mchezaji {player_id}. Hatua halali: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' au w/s/a/d.
Lengo: ishi zaidi ya wengine wote. Trails ni za kifo; kugonga ukuta kunaua; kukutana kwa kichwa kunaua wote wawili.

game_action.invalid_death: Jalo {player_id} notho nikech tugo maok owinjore.

outcome.survived_win: Jalo {player_id} ne otony; jomamoko duto notho.
outcome.all_crashed: Jothum duto ne ogore piny dichiel.
outcome.outlived: Jalo ne odong' mangima moloyo jogo duto.
outcome.turn_limit: Ka osechopo tong' mar ng'wech, jal ma osedak kuom kinde malach moloye ema locho.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Mikusanyiko ya mwisho ya daraja (bora→mbaya zaidi): {groups}
